grammar.title: 1-bo'lim: Present Simple (Hozirgi oddiy zamon)
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Present Simple — doimiy odat, umumiy haqiqat yoki jadval bo'yicha ishlarni ifodalaydi. ✅ Tuzilishi: I/You/We/They + fe'l (V1); He/She/It + fe'l+s/es ✅ Misol: 'I work every day.' / 'She works every day.' ✅ Salbiy: don't/doesn't + V1 ✅ So'roq: Do/Does + ega + V1? 🔑 Belgilovchi so'zlar: always, usually, often, every day/week, on Mondays.

grammar.title: 2-bo'lim: Present Continuous (Hozirgi davom zamon)
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Present Continuous — hozir, shu daqiqada sodir bo'layotgan harakatni bildiradi. ✅ Tuzilishi: am/is/are + fe'l+ing ✅ Misol: 'I am reading a book now.' ✅ Salbiy: am/is/are + not + V-ing ✅ So'roq: Am/Is/Are + ega + V-ing? 🔑 Belgilovchi so'zlar: now, at the moment, right now, look!, listen!

grammar.title: 3-bo'lim: Past Simple va Past Continuous (O'tgan zamon)
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Past Simple — o'tgan vaqtda tugallangan harakat. ✅ Muntazam fe'llar: V+ed (worked); noto'g'ri fe'llar alohida yodlanadi (go→went). ✅ Misol: 'I worked yesterday.' 📘 Past Continuous — o'tgan vaqtda davom etayotgan harakat. ✅ Tuzilishi: was/were + V-ing ✅ Misol: 'I was working when she called.' 🔑 Belgilovchi so'zlar: yesterday, last week, ago, when, while.

grammar.title: 4-bo'lim: Present Perfect (Hozirgi tugallangan zamon)
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Present Perfect — o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgi vaqtga bog'liq bo'lgan yoki tajriba bildiruvchi harakat. ✅ Tuzilishi: have/has + V3 (past participle) ✅ Misol: 'I have visited London.' / 'She has never been to Japan.' 🔑 Belgilovchi so'zlar: already, just, yet, ever, never, since, for.

grammar.title: 5-bo'lim: Modal fe'llar va Passive Voice
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Modal fe'llar (must, have to, should, can) — majburiyat, tavsiya, imkoniyatni bildiradi. ✅ Misol: 'You must finish this today.' 📘 Passive Voice — harakatni bajaruvchidan ko'ra harakatning o'ziga urg'u berish uchun ishlatiladi. ✅ Tuzilishi: be + V3 ✅ Misol: 'The book was written by him.'

grammar.title: 6-bo'lim: Future Simple va Shart gaplar (Conditionals)
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Future Simple — kelajakdagi harakat, qaror yoki bashorat. ✅ Tuzilishi: will + V1 ✅ Misol: 'I will call you tomorrow.' 📘 Zero/First Conditional — shart va uning natijasi. ✅ 'If it rains, I will stay home.' (real shart) ✅ 'If you heat water, it boils.' (umumiy haqiqat)

grammar.title: 7-bo'lim: Murakkab grammatika
grammar.text_explanation: 📘 Bu bo'limda quyidagilarni o'rganasiz: ✅ Third Conditional — o'tmishdagi noreal shart: 'If I had known, I would have acted differently.' ✅ Inversiya: 'Not only was he late...' ✅ Future Perfect: 'By next year, she will have worked here for a decade.' ✅ Wish + Past Perfect: 'I wish I had had more time.'

vocabulary.title: 1-bo'lim: Kundalik so'zlar
vocabulary.text_explanation:
📗 Kundalik hayotda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlar: uy-ro'zg'or, oziq-ovqat, oddiy sifatlar (katta/kichik, issiq/sovuq) va boshqalar.

💡 Maslahat: har bir yangi so'zni gap ichida yodlang, yolg'iz so'z sifatida emas.

vocabulary.title: 2-bo'lim: Foydali iboralar
vocabulary.text_explanation:
📗 Bu bo'limda kundalik muloqotda va ishda foydali bo'lgan fe'l va iboralarni o'rganasiz (masalan: postpone, achieve, reliable).

💡 Maslahat: sinonim va antonimlarni birga yodlash tezroq eslab qolishga yordam beradi.

vocabulary.title: 3-bo'lim: Murakkab lug'at
vocabulary.text_explanation:
📗 Yuqori darajadagi (C1) so'zlar — ilmiy, rasmiy va nozik ma'noli so'zlar: ambiguous, meticulous, ubiquitous va h.k.

💡 Maslahat: bu so'zlarni maqola o'qishda, IELTS Writing'da ishlatishga harakat qiling.
